statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) = n and for every i with 0 <= i < n, r[i] = sum_{k=1}^{len(words[i])} score(i,k), where score(i,k) is the number of indices j with 0 <= j < n such that k <= len(words[j]) and for every t with 0 <= t < k, words[i][t] = words[j][t].
preconditions: words is a slice of byte vectors; let n = len(words). 1 <= n <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 1000; every byte of every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97..122).

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail) for every words satisfying the preconditions.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i,j with 0 <= i,j < n, if words[i] is a prefix of words[j] (len(words[i]) <= len(words[j]) and words[i][t] = words[j][t] for all 0 <= t < len(words[i])), then r[j] - r[i] >= len(words[j]) - len(words[i]).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n, r[i] = sum_{j=0}^{n-1} lcp(words[i], words[j]), where for byte strings x,y, lcp(x,y) is the largest L with 0 <= L <= min(len(x),len(y)) such that x[t] = y[t] for every t with 0 <= t < L.
preconditions: words is a slice of byte vectors; let n = len(words). 1 <= n <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 1000; every byte of every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97..122).
